c: When an accepted major incident is Resolved, a draft post-incident review is created for it.
say: When an accepted major incident is resolved, a draft post-incident review is created for it.

c: Open the Post incident report tab. Major incident managers, the assignee and co-authors can edit; add co-authors with Edit Co-contributors.
say: Open the post incident report tab. Major incident managers, the assignee and the co-authors can edit it. Add co-authors with edit co-contributors.

c: Edit Report: the draft starts with Summary, Impact and Resolution from the incident. Complete them and Save Report.
say: Choose edit report. The draft starts with a summary, the impact and the resolution, taken from the incident. Complete them and save the report.

c: The timeline holds the milestones, incident tasks and flagged activity entries. Hide events, or Add Timeline Event for what the records miss.
say: The timeline holds the milestones, the incident tasks and any activity entries someone flagged. Hide what doesn't help, and add events the records miss.

c: Preview it, Download the PDF, then Mark published. To correct it, Unpublish first.
say: Preview the report, download the PDF, then mark it published. It can't be edited while published; unpublish it to correct it.

c: A banner says Publish post incident report by …: 24 hours after resolution on pdi2. Nobody is emailed.
say: A banner shows the deadline: twenty-four hours after resolution on pdi2. Only the banner tells you; nobody is emailed.
